title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

evidence_spans.quote: Methods: In this study, a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy was constructed
a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy
Thymic atrophy marks the onset of immune aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary mouse study evaluates an intervention against thymic atrophy explicitly identified as the onset of immune aging and reports a current-report multi-omics analysis.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Ganoderma lucidum spores (GLS), including sporoderm-removed GLS (RGLS), administered in mice with estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy without GLS/RGLS treatment
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Thymic epithelial-cell apoptosis, thymic damage, and double-positive thymocyte/T-cell development and CD4+ T-cell output
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Effect of GLS/RGLS treatment on EB-induced thymic injury and T-cell developmental outcomes relative to EB-induced injury without GLS/RGLS

evidence_spans.quote: the improvement effect of GLS on thymic atrophy was evaluated
GLS effectively mitigates EB-induced thymic damage
attenuating apoptotic thymic epithelial cells (TECs) and enhancing the output of CD4+ T cells
RGLS suppresses EB-induced upregulation of Abpob and Apoa4

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The completed mouse study evaluates GLS/RGLS treatment in an EB-induced thymic-atrophy model and reports between-condition treatment effects on tissue injury and T-cell developmental outcomes.
